provenance.license_note: Hardware identification data (PCI IDs, names, support flags) recorded as evidence; the package's driver EULA and binaries are not redistributed.
provenance.signature_verification: gpgv against the key extracted from cuda-keyring 1.1-1 (Good signature); Packages.gz SHA256 matches InRelease

support_classes.meaning: legacy branch 390 or older (Fermi and earlier; 367 is Kepler GRID)
no legacy branch; kernelopen and gsp_proprietary_supported (Turing, Ampere, Ada Lovelace, Hopper)
no legacy branch; kernelopen without gsp_proprietary_supported (Blackwell and newer)

upstream_anomalies.note: Upstream flags these legacy-580 (Maxwell/Pascal/Volta) chips 'kernelopen', but NVIDIA's open-gpu-kernel-modules README states the open modules support Turing and later only. The legacy branch, not the flag, is authoritative for these chips.
